_comment: Evaluation-domain term/alias map for EXT-005 cross-vault candidate discovery (CAP-013). Canonical term -> aliases. Built from the actual content of batch 004 (master-ai '05 - ML Evaluation Metrics.md', 43 KUs) and batch 005 (ai-course 03.6 Model Evaluation, 5 files, 275 KUs); every term and alias is verified to occur inside at least one in-scope KU excerpt by scripts/ext005_term_map.py (reports/extraction/ext005-term-map-verification.json). No French aliases: the evaluation batches contain no French lab content (probe: précision/rappel/exactitude/métrique/seuil/étiquette all absent). NOTE on 'mAP': case-insensitive word-boundary matching deliberately lets ai-course 'mAP' (CV detection, mAP@0.5) collide with master-ai 'MAP' (ranking Mean Average Precision) AND with ai-course L495 'mAP' in the ranking sense — the shared-name cases are exactly what evidence-based classification must adjudicate (F-0006 rules remain mandatory; 'Color map' at ai-course L436 will produce a spurious candidate that classification must dismiss). Formula-level and description-level identities invisible to term matching (e.g. master-ai's unnamed Huber description vs ai-course's named Huber loss; master-ai's unnamed confusion-matrix table vs ai-course's named confusion matrix) are classified as judgments with byte-exact quote evidence, per the EXT-003 precedent. Keys starting with _ are documentation and ignored by the loader.
